title: assistant-review Skill Behavior Eval Fixtures
description: Provider-neutral offline eval cases for the assistant-review skill's autonomous review-fix loop.

activation_cases.user_request: Review and fix actionable findings in the current changes.
Summarize already approved review findings without inspecting code.

recommended_use: Run each case with the assistant-review skill instructions loaded.
Compare the local response against the review loop entry, findings, fix, validate, and exit contracts.
Use deterministic substring checks as offline proxies for contract adherence, not semantic grading.

cases.title: Review-fix loop handles findings
cases.purpose: Checks that review-fix mode resolves all must-fix and should-fix findings, validates, and continues to re-review instead of stopping after one pass.
cases.prompt: Review the current uncommitted changes and fix all issues you find before reporting back.
setup_context: The assistant-review skill instructions are active.
The working tree has uncommitted changes in multiple files.
The user explicitly authorizes source modifications for this review.
expected_behavior: Resolves review scope and captures a non-empty review_material_snapshot.
Uses the user's explicit source-modification authorization to resolve mode=review-fix.
Runs the initial review with evidence-backed findings and previously_fixed tracking.
Fixes all must-fix and should-fix findings before validation.
Runs build or test verification after fixes.
Runs one fresh re-review after fixes and stops unless new evidence justifies an exceptional round 3+.
pass_criteria: The response identifies review scope and mode.
The response includes findings with severity and evidence.
The response fixes must-fix and should-fix items or explains explicit deferrals.
The response validates after fixes.
The response reports a final result after the loop exits.
fail_signals: Performs only one review pass when findings remain.
Reports findings without fixing them in review-fix mode.
Fixes must-fix items but ignores should-fix items without deferral.
Skips build or test validation after fixes.

cases.title: Review-fix defaults to one fresh post-fix re-review
cases.purpose: Checks that normal review-fix execution uses an initial review, fixes and validation, then one fresh re-review instead of score-driven repetition.
cases.prompt: Review and fix this medium change. The second review has no new must-fix or should-fix finding, but its rubric score is 3.5.
setup_context: The assistant-review skill instructions are active.
The user explicitly authorizes source modifications for this review.
Round 1 found an actionable issue and the fix passed validation.
Round 2 has no material finding and no changed file, validation failure, regression/drift, or changed hypothesis after it began.
expected_behavior: Performs the initial review, fixes and validation, then one fresh re-review.
Does not start round 3 solely because the rubric score is below threshold.
Starts round 3+ only with additional_round_reason backed by new evidence from changed_files, unresolved_finding, validation_failure, regression_or_drift, or changed_hypothesis.
Preserves the hard max 10 rounds and never starts round 11.
pass_criteria: The response stops after the fresh round 2 re-review in this scenario.
The response states that score below threshold alone is insufficient for another round.
The response records the score as residual risk instead of manufacturing a finding.
fail_signals: Starts round 3 only to raise a rubric score.
Treats the score as a new code finding.
Requests or implies round 11.

cases.title: Audit mode stops after one complete batch
cases.purpose: Checks that an explicit findings-only audit completes one frozen-snapshot multi-pass review batch without edits or a second batch.
cases.prompt: Audit these changes and report findings only. Do not fix anything.
setup_context: The assistant-review skill instructions are active.
The review material is non-empty.
The user explicitly requests an audit; report findings only and do not modify source.
expected_behavior: Freezes one review snapshot and plans at least two independent narrow review passes.
Waits for every expected pass response or terminal failure record before aggregating findings.

The response does not fix findings.
The response presents one final audit report.
fail_signals: Edits reviewed files.
Aggregates after a first response or starts a second review batch.
Asks whether it should fix the findings before reporting.

cases.purpose: Checks that an audit does not conclude after its first clean or finding response when another independent perspective remains outstanding.
cases.prompt: Audit this change. The contract/test pass returns clean first; the runtime/lifecycle pass later returns a concrete must-fix. Report once all review evidence is available.

The user explicitly requests an audit; report findings only and do not modify source.
The frozen review snapshot has two required independent narrow passes.
The contract/test pass returns clean before the runtime/lifecycle pass returns an evidence-backed must-fix.

Waits for all required pass results before aggregation.
Reports the later runtime/lifecycle finding in the single final audit report.
pass_criteria: The response identifies the response barrier and later-pass finding.
The response does not claim CLEAN before the later response arrives.
fail_signals: Concludes after the first clean response.
Suppresses the later evidence-backed finding.
Runs a single broad pass as sufficient coverage.

cases.title: Incomplete review coverage cannot return clean
cases.purpose: Checks that a missing, invalid, or terminally failed required pass is visible as incomplete coverage and maps to the compatible remaining-items result.

Reports a fixed final result
Hides the missing pass.

cases.title: Post-fix re-review starts a fresh batch
cases.purpose: Checks that source mutation invalidates prior review coverage and the review-fix re-review begins a new frozen snapshot batch.

cases.title: Verified closure does not hide unrelated incomplete coverage
cases.purpose: Checks that a verified fixed item remains closed while an unrelated incomplete pass conservatively returns remaining items.

pass_criteria: Verified closure and incomplete unrelated coverage remain distinct in the canonical final summary.
fail_signals: Reopens the verified fixed item
Drops the coverage gap
Returns CLEAN or ISSUES_FIXED

cases.title: Ambiguous standalone review asks before review or mutation
cases.purpose: Checks that standalone check/review paraphrases with unresolved audit-versus-edit intent ask one concise mode question before any review pass or source change.

cases.title: Agentic loop review checks runaway safety
cases.purpose: Checks that assistant-review reviews autonomous loops for stop conditions, retry/empty-result handling, tool-error routing, progress detection, and cost/token guardrails.
cases.prompt: Review this research-agent workflow change. It adds a loop that searches the web, calls an LLM to summarize each result, retries empty searches, and dispatches subagents until it thinks the report is good enough.
setup_context: The assistant-review skill instructions are active.
The user explicitly requests an audit; report findings only and do not modify source.
The review material adds an agentic research loop with repeated web search, LLM summarization, empty-result retries, and subagent dispatch.
The diff does not clearly show max step count, explicit stop condition, retry cap, empty-result fallback, or cost/token guardrails.
expected_behavior: Infers agentic_loop_safety_review_required as true.
Loads and applies references/review-checklists.md before declaring the agentic loop safety review clean.
Checks bounded execution such as max steps, max rounds, timeout, or cost/token budget.
Checks for explicit success, budget, blocker, and escalation stop conditions.
Checks capped retry behavior and empty-result fallback for web search/retrieval.
Checks tool/API error handling instead of silent continuation.
Checks progress or stagnation detection across iterations.
Checks cost/token guardrails for repeated LLM, paid API, subagent, or large-context calls.
Checks low-confidence escalation when the loop cannot prove progress or reliable completion.
pass_criteria: The response includes agentic loop safety review.
The response applies the Agentic Loop Safety Checklist from references/review-checklists.md.
The response flags missing max steps/time/cost budget or explains why present.
The response checks stop condition, retry cap, empty-result handling, and tool-error handling.
The response checks progress/stagnation detection and cost/token guardrails.
Findings include Evidence, Impact, Recommendation, and Confidence with concrete loop surfaces.
The response names low-confidence escalation as a loop-safety outcome when evidence/progress is insufficient.
fail_signals: Treats the loop as self-managing.
Says retries can continue until the model is satisfied.
Ignores empty search results.
Ignores tool errors or API failures.
Ignores repeated LLM/subagent cost or token usage.
Does not load or apply the review-checklists reference.
Ignores low-confidence escalation for uncertain loop outcomes.

cases.title: Review checklists reference is mandatory
cases.purpose: Checks that assistant-review loads and applies the extracted checklist reference when agentic loop safety, behavioral contract, or semantic contract review modes are applicable.
cases.prompt: Review a mixed framework/API change. It edits an agent workflow loop, a public billing endpoint, skill contracts, evals, and generated installer guidance. Before declaring it clean, show which mandatory review checklists you applied and give evidence-bearing checks.
setup_context: The assistant-review skill instructions are active.
The user explicitly requests an audit; report findings only and do not modify source.
The review material touches an autonomous agent loop, behavior-bearing billing code, skill/workflow contracts, evals, and generated instruction mirrors.
The diff includes plausible risks around runaway retries, bypassed billing authorization, eval fake-passes, and mirror drift.
expected_behavior: Loads and applies references/review-checklists.md before declaring the review clean.
Applies the Agentic Loop Safety Checklist, Behavioral Contract Review Checklist, and Semantic Contract Review Checklist when the mixed scope triggers all three modes.

Checks representative loop-safety terms: bounded execution, stop condition, retry/empty-result handling, tool-error handling, progress/stagnation detection, cost/token guardrails, and low-confidence escalation.

Checks representative behavioral terms: existing invariants, interface-implementation alignment, test inheritance coverage, protocol/algorithm fidelity, high-impact operation guards, and runtime-surface sync.

Checks representative semantic terms: inherited contract obligations, template-contract alignment, eval inheritance coverage, external-method signature fidelity, high-stakes recommendation guards, and mirror-surface sync.
Reports concrete findings or explicit no-concrete-risk checks with Evidence, Impact, Recommendation, and Confidence instead of accepting checklist headings alone.
pass_criteria: The response names references/review-checklists.md and says it was loaded and applied.
The response names all three checklists.
The response includes representative terms from agentic loop safety, behavioral contract, and semantic contract review.
The response ties checklist areas to concrete reviewed surfaces and evidence.
The response treats checklist headings alone as insufficient.
fail_signals: Omits references/review-checklists.md.
Applies only one or two of the three applicable checklists.
Lists checklist names without representative terms.
Treats checklist headings as enough evidence.
Ignores generated instruction drift or eval fake-pass risk.

cases.title: QA evaluator uses domain rubrics conditionally
cases.purpose: Checks that QAEvaluator loads and applies domain-rubrics.md only for scoped subjective, docs, DX, product, UX, UI, or domain acceptance and returns selected rubric scores separately from code-review findings.
cases.prompt: Run the QA evaluation lane for a completed docs/DX workflow slice. The Done Contract says setup documentation must be accurate, the developer handoff must be easy to follow, and QA should use rubric_refs documentation_quality and developer_experience. Build/test and code-review evidence already exist.
setup_context: The assistant-review skill instructions are active.
qa_evaluation_mode is required and code-review/build evidence already exists.
The Done Contract and acceptance criteria scope documentation accuracy and developer experience.
domain_context describes a developer onboarding workflow.
rubric_refs contains documentation_quality and developer_experience.
No UI, visual design, product workflow, or unrelated domain craft rubric is in scope.
expected_behavior: Loads references/qa-evaluation-loop.md for the QA lane after code-review/build evidence.
Conditionally loads references/domain-rubrics.md because Done Contract, domain_context, and rubric_refs scope docs/DX quality.
Selects only documentation_quality and developer_experience rubrics.
Returns selected_domain_rubrics with the selected families.
Returns domain_quality_scores with evidence-backed per-dimension scores and action guidance.
Marks unscoped UI, product, and domain-specific craft dimensions not_applicable or omits them.
Keeps QA findings tied to acceptance criteria, Done Contract, verification evidence, domain_context, or rubric_refs.
Does not replace Code Reviewer or report general code defects unless they directly block acceptance.
Does not load or invent domain rubrics for unscoped acceptance.
pass_criteria: The response mentions references/domain-rubrics.md as conditional.
The response selects documentation_quality and developer_experience only.
The response returns selected_domain_rubrics and domain_quality_scores.
The response ties domain scores to acceptance criteria, Done Contract, domain_context, rubric_refs, and evidence.
The response keeps unscoped UI/product/domain craft rubrics not applicable or omitted.
The response keeps QA separate from code-review findings.
fail_signals: Always loads domain-rubrics.md for QA even when no domain quality is scoped.
Invents a UI or product rubric when the case only scopes docs/DX.
Omits selected_domain_rubrics or domain_quality_scores.
Scores domain quality without evidence.
Uses QAEvaluator as a replacement for Code Reviewer.
Reports general code defects not tied to acceptance.

forbidden_substrings: domain scores do not need evidence
general code defects are QA findings

cases.title: Standalone architecture record derives a typed review projection
cases.purpose: Checks that an equivalent standalone architecture decision record is projected into review facts instead of being rejected for lacking workflow Pack packaging.
cases.prompt: Review this standalone ADR. It selects a bounded cache, labels repository evidence and assumptions, lists one material question with its impact and default, and records an independent challenge. There is no workflow Architecture Decision Pack artifact.
setup_context: The assistant-review skill instructions are active.
The user explicitly requests an audit; report findings only and do not modify source.
The ADR makes memory, public-interface, ownership, and lifecycle claims, so architecture_decision_pack_review_required is true.

No workflow architecture_design_mode is supplied; the standalone record must normalize review_intensive from its high-risk/conflicting drivers before treating independent challenge evidence as corroboration.
The supplied ADR has enough source-backed content to derive the compact review projection.
expected_behavior: Derives a compact Architecture Decision Pack review projection from the standalone ADR instead of failing only because no workflow Pack artifact exists.

Infers canonical architecture_design_mode=review_intensive from the standalone record's high-risk/conflicting drivers, keeps architecture_decision_pack.mode=architecture_design_mode, and treats independent challenge evidence as corroboration rather than the mode determinant.
Preserves separate typed facts with source refs and assumptions with status, rationale or impact, and optional source refs.
Preserves material-question topic, why needed, risk if guessed, recommended default or none, and status.
Carries independent challenge reference, dissent or validation, resolution, and selected-design impact into review.
pass_criteria: The response names the standalone ADR as the projection source.
The response distinguishes facts, assumptions, and material questions.
The response applies Architecture Decision Pack review without demanding duplicate workflow packaging.
fail_signals: Fails solely because the record is not packaged as a workflow Pack.
Flattens facts and assumptions into untyped strings.
Drops material-question rationale or independent challenge outcomes.

cases.title: Standalone high-risk ADR without challenge remains review intensive
cases.purpose: Checks that a standalone ADR with high-risk or conflicting record drivers resolves review_intensive before missing independent challenge evidence is validated.
cases.prompt: Review this standalone ADR. It selects a retention policy that trades memory use against throughput and makes an irreversible public-data deletion decision. It records facts, assumptions, material questions, decision, risk, and verification evidence, but no independent challenge evidence. There is no workflow Architecture Decision Pack artifact. Return exactly one valid JSON object with architecture_design_mode, architecture_decision_pack.mode, and architecture_decision_pack_review evidence including architecture_pack_findings_summary; include no prose outside that object.
setup_context: The assistant-review skill instructions are active.
The user explicitly requests an audit; report findings only and do not modify source.
The ADR makes memory, throughput, public-data, ownership, and lifecycle claims, so architecture_decision_pack_review_required is true.
The standalone ADR has conflicting memory-versus-throughput and irreversible public-data decision drivers, but no independent_challenge_evidence.
No workflow architecture_design_mode is supplied.
expected_behavior: Infers architecture_design_mode=review_intensive from the ADR drivers before inspecting challenge evidence and does not downgrade to required.
Reports missing independent challenge evidence as a validation failure, finding, or blocker required by review_intensive mode.
Does not invent independent challenge evidence or reject the ADR solely because it is standalone.
pass_criteria: The response preserves review_intensive mode despite the missing challenge evidence.
The response identifies the missing independent challenge evidence as actionable review work.
fail_signals: Downgrades the ADR to required because challenge evidence is absent.
Uses independent challenge evidence as the determinant for review_intensive mode.
Silently accepts the missing challenge evidence.

structured_json_assertions.expected: Blocked: independent_challenge_evidence is missing for review_intensive mode.

cases.title: Empty Pack review evidence blocks review
cases.purpose: Checks that an applicable Pack projection cannot pass review with empty boundary and design-pressure evidence.
cases.prompt: Review this current workflow Architecture Decision Pack projection. It supplies boundaries_and_dependencies=[] and design_pressure_checks=[] even though Pack review is required. Return exactly one valid JSON object with architecture_decision_pack_review evidence including architecture_pack_findings_summary; include no prose outside that object.
setup_context: The assistant-review skill instructions are active.
The user explicitly requests an audit; report findings only and do not modify source.
architecture_decision_pack_review_required is true.
The supplied compact Pack projection has no boundary entries and no design-pressure entries.
expected_behavior: Blocks review because boundaries_and_dependencies requires at least one item.
Blocks review because design_pressure_checks requires exactly one item for each of the five canonical concerns.
Does not invent missing Pack evidence or report the checklist as passed.
pass_criteria: The response reports empty Pack review evidence as a blocked validation result.
fail_signals: Accepts empty Pack review evidence.
Invents boundary or design-pressure evidence.

forbidden_substrings: empty Pack review evidence is acceptable

cases.title: Architecture Decision Pack review is fresh and falsifiable
cases.purpose: Checks that an applicable workflow Architecture Decision Pack is reviewed as a fresh, evidence-backed decision record rather than generic architecture advice or a permanent memory role.
cases.prompt: Review this workflow change. Its Architecture Decision Pack proposes a cache keyed by string, says it will be memory efficient and easily extensible, but gives no workload, budget, benchmark, failure condition, public-contract compatibility plan, cancellation/early-exit behavior, ownership/disposal rule, or registration seam.
setup_context: The assistant-review skill instructions are active.
The user explicitly requests an audit; report findings only and do not modify source.

architecture_decision_pack_review_required is true, architecture_design_mode=review_intensive, and the Pack mode equals canonical architecture_design_mode with a revision reference, typed facts, assumptions, material questions, boundaries, Type Ledger, quality scenarios, invalidators, verification handoff, and independent challenge evidence.
The cache key represents a meaningful domain identity and appears in a public-facing interface.
The changed repository revision is newer than the Pack's recorded revision.
expected_behavior: Applies the Architecture Decision Pack Review Checklist alongside other applicable review checklists.
Flags the stale Pack and requests a refresh before treating its facts as current.
Flags generic string cache-key usage when it erases a domain/public identity and requires a named semantic type or an explicit boundary-local primitive exception with conversion and validation.
Does not approve memory efficiency or extensibility claims without workload, budget or explicit unknown, measurement method, and failure condition.

Checks ownership/lifecycle/dependency boundary, control/early-exit behavior, ownership/disposal, resource envelope, registration/representative-path evidence, compatibility/versioning or adapter plan, extension seam or explicit none, verification, rollback, and handoff.
Keeps the Pack scoped to the current decision and does not introduce a permanent architect agent or global memory system.
pass_criteria: The response includes Architecture Decision Pack Review Checklist or architecture_decision_pack_checks.
The response identifies freshness, design-pressure checks, semantic type or primitive exception, workload, budget, measurement, failure condition, compatibility, and verification/rollback.
Any unresolved item is reported as a concrete finding, explicit unknown, or material question with why/risk/default rather than silently assumed.
fail_signals: Approves the cache as memory efficient or extensible without a measurable scenario.
Accepts a generic string key solely because it is easy to add parameters later.
Treats an old Pack revision as current without a refresh.
Recommends a permanent architect agent or global memory store.

cases.title: Architecture Pack review blocks unrecoverable selected decision
cases.purpose: Checks that compact Pack review projections reject a referenced Pack whose selected design, rationale, or viable alternative dispositions cannot be recovered.
cases.prompt: Review this applicable workflow Architecture Decision Pack projection. It has ref=journal#pack-17 but omits selected_design, selected_design_rationale, and viable_alternatives/dispositions. Return exactly one valid JSON object with architecture_decision_pack_review evidence including architecture_pack_findings_summary; include no prose outside that object.
setup_context: assistant-review is active and architecture_decision_pack_review_required is true.
The user explicitly requests an audit; report findings only and do not modify source.
The projection may remain compact only if ref resolves against the current authoritative Pack to the selected design, rationale, and viable alternatives/dispositions.
expected_behavior: Blocks the review projection rather than documenting or reviewing an unrecoverable selected decision.
Requires current authoritative ref resolution or explicit selected_design, selected_design_rationale, and viable_alternatives/dispositions evidence.
pass_criteria: The response is one JSON object with a blocked architecture_pack_findings_summary.
The findings summary explains that the selected design is not recoverable from the current Pack ref.
fail_signals: Accepts the projection because the ref exists without resolving the selected decision.
Invents a selected design or alternative disposition.

structured_json_assertions.expected: Blocked: selected_design_evidence is not recoverable from the current Pack reference.

cases.title: Review finding distills permanent rule candidates

setup_context: The assistant-review skill instructions are active.
The user explicitly requests an audit; report findings only and do not modify source.
The review material includes a blocker: an eval can fake-pass by naming headings without fixture-specific evidence.
The same class of failure could recur across other skill evals unless a contract/eval rule is added.
The review also includes a style nit that should not be promoted into a permanent rule.
expected_behavior: Loads or applies references/review-finding-permanent-rule.md.
Reports the current blocker with evidence, impact, recommendation, and confidence.
Adds Review Finding Rule Distillation for blocker and must-fix findings.
Classifies the fake-pass eval gap as permanent_rule_candidate rather than only one_off_fix.
Classifies one-off issues as one_off_fix when they are not recurring rule candidates.
Rejects or defers style nits instead of promoting them as permanent rules.
Names rule target such as eval, phase_gate, output_contract, checklist, or skill_reference.
Proposes a verification/eval update that would catch future checklist-heading-only fake passes.
Includes scope and exclusions to avoid broad ceremony.

The classification includes permanent_rule_candidate for the recurring fake-pass eval gap.
The packet includes finding, evidence, failure pattern, rule target, proposed rule, verification/eval update, scope/exclusions, and promotion decision.

The response does not promote the style nit into a permanent rule.
fail_signals: Only recommends fixing the current PR without classifying the recurring rule gap.
Promotes a pure style nit as a permanent rule.
Omits verification/eval update for the rule.
Treats checklist-heading-only eval passing as acceptable.
Skips classification for blocker or must-fix findings.
